name: Super Powers Mobility (SPM)
long_description:
We started off building the highest performance, 470 volt electric off-road vehicles but we realized our ultra power dense battery packs are useful for mobile and stationary energy storage and power export, for military and consumer use cases. We develop battery packs, power electronics, and traction powertrain systems for vehicles.

For the majority of 2026 we were marketing our electric off-road vehicles, but we pivoted to selling our high performance battery packs and power export capabilities in the month of September. We went from having $769,000 in consumer pre-orders (possibly low conversion rate to sales) to $421,815 in realized revenue in 1 month, with a $792,000 qualified pipeline. 

Our tech is so compelling because the safety and layout of high voltage battery packs has only been mastered by large, well funded OEM companies who have brought it in-house. That means all other companies without the in-house expertise rely on battery companies to develop packs, and power electronics companies to develop power export capabilities. SPM has both of those capabilities in-house so we can ensure a fast turnaround and much more reliable product. 

One of the biggest priorities of the department of war is energy dominance. We're seeing it constantly in new solicitations. Our strategy is superior - become a prime, but simultaneously service primes because most of then don't actually have the battery and power electronics expertise we have.

Founded by Jon Powers - Ex-Tesla Sr. Mechanical Integration Engineer leading Cybertruck vehicle integration.

launches.title: SPM: Batteries are the bottleneck to American Energy Dominance
launches.tagline: SPM builds highest performance battery packs and power systems to mobilize energy
launches.body:
At [SPM](https://www.spm.fun/), we’re building the highest-performance, defense-compliant battery packs and power export systems for dual-use applications. We’ve identified a huge gap in energy/mobility battery pack supply chain. 

<https://youtu.be/ScivsFG1qxw>

Mobilizing energy is a national priority, with electronic warfare and field computing requiring increasing power. Designed, manufactured, and put into low-volume production in 1/4 of the time of most incumbent battery manufacturers— SPM is filling the gap that both startups and major primes are experiencing. America needs more reliable battery pack suppliers that produce high quality, safe and reliable packs, with non-FEOC components. That’s how we’ve always done it.

We started directly selling our battery pack and power system capability to customers in August 2026 and went from pre-orders, to over $400,000 in contracted revenue in one month, with a large qualified pipeline for the remainder of the year. We are slated to become a prime contractor in 2027, but we have a much more rapid strategy right now - sell to prime contractors who needs packs - and this strategy works. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125487&key=user_uploads/1979736/ebec0c80-adc8-4781-b52f-0941a64aaefe)

Our team is scaling automated production capacity in Pittsburgh Pennsylvania - we’re booked into February 2027. Because our entire battery packs are vertically integrated except the cell, we can develop cell-agnostic custom battery packs with a patented design methodology that doesn’t require specialized manufacturing equipment. After design and low-volume production starts, any shop with a spot welder can acquire parts and finish the assembly. In the end, this strengthens domestic battery pack supply chain integrity with rapidly scalable battery packs that use a common module form factor. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=125487&key=user_uploads/1979736/848da5cf-c7c4-4dec-9ac3-1715b295b704)

Super Powers Mobility started out developing 470V 10-20 kWh high-voltage powertrain systems for light off-road vehicles and late this summer we shifted to power systems for energy mobilization and military mobility products like UGVs, UAS, and USVs. Since switching focus, SPM has joined 4 federal contracts to supply batteries and power electronics systems. 

We are expanding our team - <https://www.linkedin.com/company/superpowersmobility/jobs>

You can also check our YC Jobs page. 

Need batteries or a custom vehicle development program? Reach us at [info@spm.fun](mailto:info@spm.fun) or check our website below.

Government/enterprise website - [www.spm.us](http://www.spm.us)

I founded SPM after a 4-year career as a Sr. Mechanical Integration engineer at Tesla on the Cybertruck, 2 years at Honda R&D Americas as a powersports vehicle engineer, and 4 years as a professionally sponsored off-road racer. I searched the country for the perfect founding team to electrify the off-road industry, which ended up working perfectly for supplying battery packs and energy systems to government prime contractors. While I’m a solo founder, I could not do it without my world-class team. We look forward to growing our team and hiring the most ambitious, technically capable professionals in the world.
